name: application-tag-filter-group
title: Tag Filter Group
description: Multi-select tag filter pills — each tag toggles independently via real aria-pressed state — for filtering a list by facet.
useWhen: Filtering a list or grid by one or more independent tag facets (topics, labels, categories) with immediate visual feedback.
The number of tags is small enough to display as a wrapped row of pills (roughly under 15-20).
Multiple tags can be active simultaneously — this is multi-select, not a single-choice control.
avoidWhen: You're collecting free-form tags from user text entry — use `tag-input` for that add/remove-by-typing pattern instead.
Only one tag can be active at a time — a `segmented-control` or `toggle-group` in single-select mode better conveys that constraint.
The tag list is long or needs search — pair with a `combobox` or move it into a `faceted-search-sidebar` checkbox group instead.
responsiveBehavior: Pills wrap onto additional lines via flex-wrap as the container narrows or more tags are added, rather than overflowing or scrolling horizontally.
accessibility: The pill row has role="group" with an aria-label describing it as a tag filter.
Each pill is a real toggle button with aria-pressed reflecting its selected state, not a link or a styled checkbox hidden behind a label.
Selected vs. unselected pills are distinguished by both fill and border, not by color alone, so the state reads even without color perception.

variants.title: Tag Filter Group
variants.description: Six tag pills with two selected (Design, Frontend) and four available.
accessibility: Each tag's selection is independent real state, so any combination of tags can be active at once.

variants.title: Tag Filter Group (Dark)
variants.description: Tag filter group adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected and unselected pill colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
